messages:
elaine: Heads-up — prepping the internal release note & announce for the 03/12 deploy window. Draft below, looking for quick sign-off + pin decision.

rory: thanks! can you paste the short blurb here?

elaine: Sure — short lead then bullets. keeping public-facing copy minimal, internal notes have the ops checklist.

elaine: ```
What’s changing: Rolling out inference runtime v1.9.2 with improved prefix caching and reduced tail latency for long conversations.
Impact: ~5-12% average token cost reduction on chat workloads; no schema changes to API.
Action for teams: If you rely on pinned model versions, opt into v1.9.2 after the canary window.
Rollback plan: Immediate fallback to v1.9.1 image with automatic KV-cache flush if latency > 300ms p95 for 10m.
```

msanchez: LGTM on the copy. quick Q — are we pinning at deploy time or leaving default routing to the new runtime?

elaine: proposal: pinted for Dedicated + Private by default, hosted customers get staged rollout via traffic routing. ops can override per-tenant.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @jason for 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC. Canary targets: 3 nodes in us-west-2. Monitoring hooks enabled.

jason: yep scheduled. canaries will run for 20m then expand if healthy. I set the anomaly thresholds: p95 latency +10% and error-rate +0.5% over baseline.

priya: For the internal announce, can we add the explicit rollback triggers so oncall doesn't have to dig? suggestion: Add `latency > 300ms p95 for 10m` and `error-rate > 0.7%` as triggers.

elaine: good call — adding both. Updated note: ```Rollback triggers: p95 latency > 300ms for 10m OR error-rate > 0.7% for 5m. Oncall: run rollback script: 

./ops/rollback.sh --image v1.9.1 --flush-cache
```

rory: tiny nit: mention the config pin path. e.g., `redwood.pin.runtime_version` in Console. that reduces confusion.

elaine: added. Also linking the RN doc: https://internal.redwood/notes/2026-03-12-runtime-1-9-2 (internal only)

msanchez: Do we want to pin the model weights too? earlier we had issues with quantized variants shifting outputs during rollout.

jason: For hosted default routing we'll keep weights the same (no weight update). Dedicated customers who want the new quantization profile will opt in per their cluster. We should call out cache-warm behavior in the notes.

elaine: calling out cache-warm + KV eviction behavior in ops checklist. snippet: ```Ops checklist:
- Enable canary routing to 3 nodes
- Warm prefix cache with synthetic prompts
- Monitor p95 latency, error-rate, token throughput
- If thresholds exceeded -> rollback per triggers above
```

priya: I also recommend adding a canary pin step in Console instructions: `Console -> Deployments -> Pin runtime -> Add note` so support can see who pinned it.

rory: +1. Also remind PMs to hold on external release comms until post-canary.

elaine: Updated internal announce with those bullets. Final ask: @eng-releases — quick reactions: :thumbsup: to ship as-is, :eyes: if you want to review more deeply, :no_entry_sign: to block. Goal: ship draft internal announce to #general-internal by EOD tomorrow.

msanchez: :thumbsup:

jason: :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary complete — no anomalies detected during 20m window. Safe to expand per rollout policy.

elaine: Great. I'll send the pinned internal announce in 30m and attach the RN doc + rollback playbook. Thanks all.
